pure.summary: The handler calls virtual modules, so it is not a pure function of the request.

read_only.summary: Every virtual-module call is read-classified: no state is mutated.

stateless.summary: Read-only and no cache reads: the handler never depends on mutable state.

retry_safe.summary: Read-only, or every write is inside a durable step: safe to retry. Checked across 3 enumerated path(s) (exhaustive).

deterministic.summary: No Date.now(), Math.random(), or performance.now() on any enumerated path: every run of a request is identical.

has_egress.summary: The handler makes no outbound fetch calls.

no_secret_leakage.summary: No secret-labelled value reaches a response body, header, or egress call.

no_credential_leakage.summary: No credential-labelled value reaches a response body or log.

input_validated.summary: All user input passes a validation step before any egress call.

pii_contained.summary: User input never flows to an external egress host.

idempotent.summary: Deterministic and retry-safe: safe under at-least-once delivery. Checked across 3 enumerated path(s) (exhaustive).

injection_safe.summary: No unvalidated user input reaches a SQL or HTML sink.

state_isolated.summary: No module-scope mutation in the handler body: requests cannot leak state into one another.

fault_covered.summary: All 1 failable I/O site(s) have an explicit failure path, across 3 enumerated path(s).

results_safe.summary: Every Result.ok access is guarded before the value is used. Checked across 3 enumerated path(s) (exhaustive).

optional_safe.summary: Every optional value is narrowed before use. Checked across 3 enumerated path(s) (exhaustive).

post_only.summary: The handler's AOT route table (routerMatch) is non-empty and every route's method is POST.

canonical.summary: The handler is in Canonical Normal Form: zero ZTS6xx canonical-profile errors. A non-idiomatic spelling is reported at advisory severity and does not deny this property.

cost_bounded.summary: Worst-path module-call count is bounded by the request. Checked across 3 enumerated path(s) (exhaustive).
